name: 62522 · Decatur, IL
findings: ZIP 62522 (Decatur) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62522 (Decatur) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62522 (Decatur) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
